title: Dewey Club and Tulane Club near his home
summary: Describes the social clubs around the corner from his childhood home, and where the Dewey Club building stands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Do you remember some of the earliest parades that you were going, what the parades were like? Did you ever follow them?

Well, I couldn't follow the parades, but I seen a lot of parades though. I seen a lot of old musicians in the parade bands playing too. In fact, I knew them all, because I was right around the corner from the Dewey Club and the Tulane Club.
What was the other club?
Dewey. Dewey. How do you remember? D-E-W-E-Y-S. Deweys. That was on Roman, between Perdida and Gravia. Oh yeah, right there that you're laying there.
Right around the corner.
Right around the corner from the Tulane.
It's pouring down a little now, I guess.
No, it's still there, but they made a large house out of it.
Well, really?
I'll have to go and take a picture. Yes, a large house there.
What was that, an organization? A social pleasure club?
Yeah, it was a social pleasure club. That's where Louis Armstrong and them used to play those fumes from.

Yeah, I didn't know that place. It's on Roman between... Between Perdida and Gravia. And where's the big church, the big cathedral or whatever it is in there? You talking about St. Joseph? St. Joseph.
St. Joseph at Tulane and Roman. Yeah. And the Tulane Club is on Gravia in there, Roman. And this is on Roman between Gravia and Perdida. Oh, yes.
And around the corner of the town. That's right. Which side of the street, the river? On the river side.
I guess we could...
What does it look like, two-story trees?
It's a two-story house now.
I guess we could tell it from the other houses along there.
Yes, you could tell that house.
I've been taking pictures of all the other houses.
It's about two doors from Perdida Street.
I'll make a note of it right now so I can get a picture of the other ones up to get it.
